message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "prioritize_visual_inspection_over_automated_reports_for_focal_abnormalities", "description": "When automated tools report normal findings or miss focal morphological features (e.g., cavities, air-fluid levels) despite clinical suspicion, prioritize direct visual inspection of original image pixels.", "applicable_conditions": "Tasks involving medical imaging interpretation where automated classifiers or report generators may overlook subtle, localized structural abnormalities or return contradictory 'normal' results.", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["medical_imaging_interpretation"], "required_tools": ["chest_xray_classifier", "chest_xray_report_generator"], "risk_level": "high", "core_action": "If automated tools (e.g., classifier, report generator) return 'normal' findings or fail to detect a specific focal abnormality while clinical context suggests otherwise: (1) Use tool outputs only to rule out widespread pathology (e.g., large consolidations); (2) Perform direct visual inspection of the original image pixels to identify specific morphological features (e.g., location, wall thickness, fluid levels); (3) Base the final diagnosis on pixel evidence rather than conflicting automated reports."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
